dialogue_texts: How did my parameters... collapse? Did someone force my way through spatial anomaly?
Their raw power defies the math.
Math only governs the things that are allowed to change and decay, my dear.
True eternity doesn't care for your variables.
The temporal anchor is dispelled. Are you back with us, Helene?
The glohm inside the Shirogane Manor was using your magic to filter the timeline distortion into this sector.
My consciousness is restored. But do not lower your guard.
The structural anomaly inside the Shirogane Manor is compounding exponentially.
What you faced here was merely a passive spillover.
It seems the owner of the manor is hosting quite a dramatic evening.
Shall we proceed, Shirogane-sama? We mustn't keep the grand finale waiting.
